scope: Orthogonal integer-grid routes, one copper layer, endpoint connectivity, board bounds, keepout and inter-net clearance. No optimal-length target. Grid pitch 2 mm, trace width 0.6 mm, pad diameter 1 mm, keepout square side 1.2 mm, minimum clearance 0.4 mm. Distinct neighboring grid routes retain at least 1.4 mm trace-edge gap.
